evidence_items.core_fact: GaN power semiconductors enable higher power efficiency, higher switching frequencies, and significantly smaller form factors compared to legacy silicon MOSFETs.
65W USB-C Power Delivery can charge typical 13-inch and 14-inch ultrabooks and fast-charging smartphones through universal Type-C negotiation.
Vietnamese office workers and tech commuters express frustration carrying heavy OEM brick chargers and worry about thermal heat dissipation and wall socket plug stability.

Shopee Vietnam search discovery reveals competitor brands (Baseus, Ugreen, Anker) priced between 300,000 VND and 700,000 VND, with customers valuing port versatility, fast laptop handshake, and compact travel size.
Vietnamese tech forum users voice strong fear of cheap knockoffs causing voltage surges or frying expensive laptop motherboards, demanding clear safety and warranty.
